about_the_game:
Performance Review: D- (Time to Step Up?)

"Hey you, Mr. 'D-Minus Performance Last Year', it's time you actually did something for this store!" — The Manager's Ultimatum.
A sudden blackmail letter has turned this ordinary(?) supermarket into the eye of a media storm. To save his job (and avoid actual work in the future), the simple-minded bird is forced to the front lines.

Explore the Town's Craziest Hotspot

Welcome to the "Well Done Supermarket" — the heart of the town and the ultimate hub for local gossip.

The inventory is... chaotic. One moment, you're at discount cookies and toilet paper; the next, you bump into unearthed cult artifacts or an AI-powered V16 Twin-Turbo Rocket.

Since the blackmail letter hit the headlines, the store is packed with onlookers just here for the drama. As you hunt for clues, you'll realize some people buy rockets for grocery runs, and others join cults just to hit the minimum spend for a discount... Wait, what is actually wrong with the people in this town?

Save the Supermarket (or just avoid the "Impending Doom')?

The blackmail letter threatened: "If this isn't resolved, someone is going to have "Impeding Doom!" The problem is... nobody knows which "this" they are talking about!

To prevent tragedy (mostly to prevent himself from getting fired), the Manager formed the "The No-Doom Unit" and shoved the "Manual of No-Doom" into your wings.

Since the source of the disaster is unknown, Bird has no choice but to solve every single request in the supermarket! From finding lost items to mediating disputes—just fill in the answers in the Manual, and maybe, just maybe, you'll survive?

Box Dog & Multi-Angle Deduction

You can't rely solely on Dunkadoo's own strength. You need a special ally.

  • The Mysterious "Box Dog": Your unconventional sidekick, lurking in cardboard boxes throughout the scene. Find him to access "Key Visions from Others' Perspectives." Through Box Dog's eyes, what details did mere mortals miss?

  • The Deduction Board: Compile gathered testimony, crime scene discoveries, and visual intel from Box Dog onto your Logic Board.

  • Slove the Problem: Use logic to filter out the noise and place the correct keywords in the blanks. The truth is often hidden within those seemingly nonsensical doodles and notes!

Wishlist Now!

Are you ready for an investigation adventure filled with laughter and brain-teasers? Smash that Wishlist button now! Help this poor Bird survive the crisis (and maybe find out how much that rocket actually costs)!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® 7 SP1
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10-compatible graphics card with at least 1GB of video memory
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

short_description: "Detective Dunkadoo" is a serious detective game. A blackmail has thrust the Well-Done supermarket into the spotlight. This crisis shatters the store and forces the employee Dunkadoo out of his passive routine. Can this bird see through the case and avert disaster before the impending doom strikes?
